After the coronary angiography, the patient was monitored in our Intermediate Care Unit. Troponin fluctuated around 900 pg/mL for the following 5 days, and then decreased too. The ECG normalised within the first 48 hours after onset of chest pain (Fig. ).

Only a moderate atrophy of cardiomyocytes indirectly indicated a prolonged or already past myocardial impairment process and was therefore compatible to a status after myocarditis.
